page_title: PAR 2-3 VER | Parma v Verona 15/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

90+3' Antoine Hainaut (Parma) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
90+1' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

90' 2 - 3 Goal! Mandela Keita finds Simon Sohm (Parma) with a clever pass. He steps inside his man on the edge of the box and whips a tremendous shot into the bottom left corner. Fantasy football! 2:3.
88' Simon Sohm (Parma) shows good awareness inside the box, but his attempt is stopped by the goalkeeper.
87' Dennis Man (Parma) attempts to find Ange-Yoan Bonny, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
85' Tomas Suslov goes off the pitch and Dani Silva (Verona) comes on.
84' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Parma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
83' Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The ball is behind the touchline and Parma will take a throw-in.
82' Verona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
79' Parma are seeing far more of the ball now.
77' Here comes a substitution. Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) is brought on as a substitute for Anas Haj Mohamed.
75' 1 - 3 Goal! Daniel Mosquera (Verona) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:3.
74' The number of shots on goal at present is 6:3.

73' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Lorenzo Montipo.
70' Ange-Yoan Bonny provides the assist in the box, but Dennis Man (Parma) places his shot a fraction wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
69' It will be a corner kick for Parma.

68' Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
67' Abdou Harroui (Verona) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Daniel Mosquera replaces him.
67' Substitution. Flavius Daniliuc (Verona) has come on for Darko Lazovic.
67' Paolo Zanetti has decided to substitute Amin Sarr and he is replaced by Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona).
66' The referee signals a substitution. Antoine Hainaut (Parma) is brought on as a substitute for Giovanni Leoni.
66' Abdou Harroui (Verona) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
65' Abdou Harroui (Verona) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
63' Ondrej Duda (Verona) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

62' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
62' Parma quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

61' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the left side of the goal, but Lorenzo Montipo pulls off a great save to deny him. The ball is out of play and Parma manage to earn a corner.
61' Tomas Suslov (Verona) is penalised for holding. Simone Sozza signals a set piece. Parma have a free kick.
57' 1 - 2 Goal - 1:2! Abdou Harroui laid the ball off to Amin Sarr (Verona), who shot from close range into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
56' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) sprays a pass out to Dennis Man, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
54' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Darko Lazovic (Verona).
54' A cross from Darko Lazovic (Verona) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
53' Verona hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
49' Parma take a short corner kick.

49' Parma force their opponents to concede a corner. What a great touch by Dennis Man (Parma) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.

46' That was close by Pontus Almqvist (Parma)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Hernani (Parma) is replaced by Mandela Keita.
46' Fabio Pecchia has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Pontus Almqvist comes on the pitch for Matteo Cancellieri (Parma).
46' The whistle blows and Simone Sozza starts the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Anas Haj Mohamed (Parma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
45+1' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Dennis Man (Parma) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
44' Darko Lazovic (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but Zion Suzuki comes off his line to gather the ball.
41' Having seen unsporting behavior, Simone Sozza shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Davide Faraoni (Verona) is the recipient.
40' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Diego Coppola (Verona) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
40' Abdou Harroui (Verona) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
38' What was Hernani (Parma) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
37' PENALTY APPEAL after Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

35' Excellent touch by Darko Lazovic (Verona)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
33' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Verona.
32' Darko Lazovic (Verona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Zion Suzuki, who smothers the ball.
29' Ondrej Duda (Verona) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Parma have been awarded a free kick.
28' Parma get a corner.
25' Simone Sozza blows his whistle after Hernani (Parma) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. A free kick has been awarded to Verona.
25' Some neat passing and movement from Parma as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.

22' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) plants a header from the edge of the box after a nice cross from the free kick. It lacks accuracy and the ball flies way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
21' Hernani (Parma) makes a slide tackle, but referee Simone Sozza blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Verona.
19' 1 - 1 Goal! Simon Sohm (Parma) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
19' Parma take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

19' Great solo effort by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) as he tricks his way through two defenders before firing a drive from just outside of the box towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper is ready and produces a stunning save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Parma are going to take it.
18' Simon Sohm (Parma) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball has crossed the sideline. Verona are taking a throw-in.
17' A player from Parma commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Verona in a dangerous position.
15' It's a throw-in for Parma.
12' Dennis Man (Parma) gets inside the box and tries to beat Lorenzo Montipo with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
11' Darko Lazovic (Verona) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Abdou Harroui.
8' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) is being substituted because of an injury. Fabio Pecchia sends Anas Haj Mohamed on the pitch.

5' 0 - 1 Abdou Harroui showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Diego Coppola (Verona) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header into the bottom right corner. It's 0:1.
5' Verona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
5' Amin Sarr (Verona) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
3' Dennis Man (Parma) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
2' A player from Verona commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. Parma are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Verona will kick-off.
Simone Sozza will supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
